description:
Space Mission Design Game is an educational and interactive game in which players take on the role of space scientists and mission designers. The main objective is to design and plan a successful space mission to explore planets, moons, stars, and other objects in the universe.

summary: A Space Mission Design Game is an interactive simulation where players design, manage, and operate a full space mission—choosing spacecraft components, instruments, launch vehicles, orbits, and budgets—using realistic NASA-inspired constraints and data.
